 iCloud Mail, Calendar, Contacts and More Experiencing Outage [Updated]
 Tuesday November 10, 2026 3:53 pm PST by Juli Clover Some iCloud services are experiencing an outage, according to Apple's System Status page. ‌iCloud‌ Calendar, ‌iCloud‌ Contacts, ‌iCloud‌ Mail, iWork for ‌iCloud‌, and Game Center are affected.
Apple says some users are experiencing issues with the services. The outage began at 5:49 p.m. Eastern Time.
 Find My is also having problems and Apple says it may be slow or unavailable.
 We'll update this article when the services are back online.
 Update: As of 7:22 p.m. ET, the ‌iCloud‌ Mail, ‌iCloud‌ Calendar, and ‌iCloud‌ Contacts outages are listed as resolved. Photos and ‌iCloud‌ sign-in are now experiencing issues.

I got an iCloud error asking me to enter my Apple Account credentials, only for it to repeatedly refuse to accept them. Meanwhile my Mac was working perfectly fine so I continue to write on it.
